subject: Data Engineering
title: What Is a Lakehouse?
description: A 60-second lesson on What Is a Lakehouse?.

hook.text: A data lake's cheap storage plus a data warehouse's reliability. That's the lakehouse — the best of both worlds.

buildup.text: The lakehouse adds ACID transactions, schema enforcement, and governance directly on top of lake storage.

discovery.text: Data stays in cheap object storage as open files, but table formats add database-like capabilities on top.

twist.text: Lakehouses don't replace warehouses for all workloads. Low-latency dashboards may still need a dedicated warehouse.

climax.text: The lakehouse architecture eliminates the need to copy data from lake to warehouse for most analytics use cases.

punchline.text: Lake storage. Warehouse features. One architecture.

quiz.question: What does a lakehouse combine?
options: Data lake storage with data warehouse reliability features
